nodes.description: Private mapping(address => uint256) storing token balances of each account.
Private nested mapping(address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spend allowances.
Private uint256 holding the total token supply.
Private string holding the token name.
Private string holding the token symbol.
Private string holding the generator version.
public transfer(address recipient, uint256 amount) delegating to _transfer with _msgSender().
public transferFrom(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) that moves tokens and decrements the caller allowance.
public approve(address spender, uint256 amount) delegating to _approve with _msgSender().
public increaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 addedValue) that adds to the current allowance.
public decreaseAllowance(address spender, uint256 subtractedValue) that subtracts from the current allowance.
internal _transfer(address sender, address recipient, uint256 amount) updating balances and emitting Transfer.
internal _mint(address account, uint256 amount) increasing totalSupply and the account balance.
internal _burn(address account, uint256 amount) decreasing balance and totalSupply.
internal _approve(address owner, address spender, uint256 amount) writing the allowance mapping.
internal virtual hook called before every transfer, mint and burn.
public view balanceOf(address account) reading the _balances mapping.
public view allowance(address owner, address spender) reading the _allowances mapping.
public view totalSupply() returning _totalSupply.
public view name() returning the _name state variable.
public view symbol() returning the _symbol state variable.
public view decimals() returning the constant 18.
public pure generator() returning the constant _GENERATOR tool URL.
public view version() returning the _version state variable.
internal view _msgSender() returning msg.sender (Context abstraction).
payable constructor of SimpleERC20 that initialises name/symbol, pays the service fee and mints the initial balance to the deployer.
msg.sender, the externally controlled caller address used for minting and allowance manipulation.
arithmetic currentAllowance - amount in transferFrom, guarded by a require on the allowance.
arithmetic _allowances[_msgSender()][spender] + addedValue, an unchecked addition on the allowance.
arithmetic currentAllowance - subtractedValue, guarded by a require on the allowance.
arithmetic updates _balances[sender] = senderBalance - amount and _balances[recipient] += amount in _transfer.
arithmetic _totalSupply += amount and _balances[account] += amount in _mint.
arithmetic _balances[account] = accountBalance - amount and _totalSupply -= amount in _burn.
external payable call IPayable(receiver).pay{value: msg.value}(serviceName) performed with an attacker-influenced receiver and forwarded value.
address recipient parameter of transfer/transferFrom/_transfer.
uint256 amount parameter of transfer/transferFrom/approve/_transfer/_mint/_burn/_approve.
address spender parameter of approve/allowance/increaseAllowance/decreaseAllowance.
address sender parameter of transferFrom and _transfer.
address owner parameter of allowance and _approve.
address account parameter of balanceOf/_mint/_burn.
address from parameter of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
address to parameter of the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
string name_ constructor parameter of ERC20/SimpleERC20.
string symbol_ constructor parameter of ERC20/SimpleERC20.
string version_ constructor parameter of GeneratorCopyright.
uint256 initialBalance_ constructor parameter of SimpleERC20 that is minted to the deployer.
address payable feeReceiver_ constructor parameter forwarded to ServicePayer.
string serviceName parameter passed to IPayable.pay.
address payable receiver parameter of the ServicePayer constructor, used as external call target.
uint256 addedValue parameter of increaseAllowance.
uint256 subtractedValue parameter of decreaseAllowance.
local uint256 currentAllowance read from _allowances in transferFrom/decreaseAllowance.
local uint256 senderBalance read from _balances in _transfer.
local uint256 accountBalance read from _balances in _burn.

edges.reason: transfer() delegates the actual token movement to _transfer().
transferFrom() first calls _transfer() to move the tokens.
transferFrom() calls _approve() to write the reduced allowance.
approve() delegates to _approve().
increaseAllowance() delegates to _approve() with the increased value.
decreaseAllowance() delegates to _approve() with the decreased value.
_transfer() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before mutating balances.
_mint() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before minting.
_burn() invokes the _beforeTokenTransfer hook before burning.
SimpleERC20 constructor mints the initial supply via _mint().
Constructor triggers the external payable IPayable.pay call with forwarded msg.value, a re-entrancy surface on the fee receiver.
_msgSender() returns the untrusted msg.sender value.
transfer() uses _msgSender() (msg.sender) as the source of funds, so the caller identity controls the transfer.
transferFrom() uses _msgSender() as the spender whose allowance is checked and decremented.
approve() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
increaseAllowance() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
decreaseAllowance() uses _msgSender() as the allowance owner.
Constructor mints the whole initial supply to the untrusted msg.sender (_msgSender()).
_transfer() reads and writes the _balances state mapping.
_transfer() performs unchecked-style balance arithmetic on sender and recipient balances.
_mint() increases the recipient entry in the _balances mapping.
_mint() increases the _totalSupply state variable.
_mint() adds amount to _totalSupply and to the account balance, an arithmetic operation on user supplied amounts.
_burn() decreases the account entry in the _balances mapping.
_burn() decreases the _totalSupply state variable.
_burn() subtracts amount from the account balance and from _totalSupply.
_approve() writes the _allowances nested mapping.
balanceOf() reads the _balances mapping.
allowance() reads the _allowances mapping.
totalSupply() reads the _totalSupply state variable.
name() returns the _name state variable.
symbol() returns the _symbol state variable.
version() returns the _version state variable.
transferFrom() subtracts the transferred amount from currentAllowance before re-approving.
increaseAllowance() adds addedValue to the stored allowance of msg.sender.
decreaseAllowance() subtracts subtractedValue from the stored allowance of msg.sender.
recipient parameter flows into the transfer() call.
amount parameter flows into the transfer() call.
amount parameter flows into the approve() call.
spender parameter flows into the approve() call.
spender parameter flows into increaseAllowance().
spender parameter flows into decreaseAllowance().
sender parameter flows into transferFrom().
recipient parameter flows into transferFrom().
amount parameter flows into transferFrom().
sender parameter flows into _transfer() and its balance debit.
recipient parameter flows into _transfer() and its balance credit.
amount parameter flows into _transfer() balance arithmetic.
owner parameter flows into _approve() allowance key.
spender parameter flows into _approve() allowance key.
amount parameter becomes the stored allowance value in _approve().
owner parameter is used as the first key in allowance().
spender parameter is used as the second key in allowance().
account parameter selects the queried entry in balanceOf().
account parameter receives the minted tokens in _mint().
amount parameter is added to totalSupply and balance in _mint().
account parameter is debited in _burn().
amount parameter is subtracted in _burn().
from parameter flows into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
to parameter flows into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
amount parameter flows into the _beforeTokenTransfer hook.
addedValue parameter is added to the caller allowance in increaseAllowance().
subtractedValue parameter is subtracted from the caller allowance in decreaseAllowance().
name_ constructor argument initialises the token name.
symbol_ constructor argument initialises the token symbol.
version_ constructor argument initialises the generator version string.
initialBalance_ constructor argument is minted to msg.sender.
feeReceiver_ constructor argument is forwarded to ServicePayer.
serviceName parameter is passed as calldata to the external IPayable.pay call.
receiver parameter is the target address of the external payable IPayable.pay call.
transferFrom() reads the allowance into the local currentAllowance.
local currentAllowance participates in the currentAllowance - amount subtraction.
_transfer() reads the sender balance into the local senderBalance.
local senderBalance participates in the senderBalance - amount subtraction.
_burn() reads the account balance into the local accountBalance.
local accountBalance participates in the accountBalance - amount subtraction.

normalization_plan.reason: recipient is only an argument of the transfer surface and has no independent behaviour.
amount is a plain value argument consumed by the transfer flow.
spender is only an argument used to index the allowance mapping in approve.
sender is only an argument selecting the debited account in transferFrom.
owner is only the allowance mapping key written by _approve.
account is only the recipient key mutated by _mint.
from is only passed to the hook and has no standalone semantics.
to is only passed to the hook and has no standalone semantics.
name_ is a construction-time argument that only initialises state.
symbol_ is a construction-time argument that only initialises state.
version_ is a construction-time argument that only initialises the version state.
initialBalance_ is consumed by the constructor mint call.
feeReceiver_ is only forwarded from the constructor to the payment call.
serviceName is only forwarded as calldata to the external pay call.
receiver is the direct target of the external payable pay call.
addedValue only feeds the allowance addition in increaseAllowance.
subtractedValue only feeds the allowance subtraction in decreaseAllowance.
currentAllowance is a short-lived local read inside transferFrom used for the subtraction.
senderBalance is a short-lived local read inside _transfer used for the subtraction.
accountBalance is a short-lived local read inside _burn used for the subtraction.
